tools.name: get_card
tools.description: The static LowerScript discount card: RxBIN/RxPCN/RxGRP codes, how to use it at the pharmacy counter, wallet-pass and card-page links, member support, and the exact compliance wording (not insurance, up to 80%). No lookup involved — always the same answer for a given language.
